name: United Kingdom
authorityName: UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI / Home Office)
description: Complete UKVI document checklists, Standard Visitor Visa guidelines, UK digital passport photo specifications (35x45mm), and financial proof criteria for 2026.
processingOverview: Standard processing takes 3 weeks (15 working days). Priority 5-day service available.
photoGuidance: Most UK visa applications use a digital photo of at least 600x750 pixels; printed photos (paper forms only) are 35x45 mm. Gov.uk accepts a plain, light-coloured background (white, cream or light grey). The photo should be recent (taken within the last month), and glasses should be avoided.
